integrity: Self-contained combinatorial proof plus reproducible, finite independent brute-force checks. Finite checks are not proofs. Source dates and mathematical comparisons are distinguished from independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Counts all labeled two-rainbow independent dominating functions only on K_p square K_q (2<=p<=q). Does not cover larger color alphabets or unrestricted Hamming dimensions. Bibliographic priority is a bounded comparison; unindexed stronger results remain possible.
title: Square-board exceptional weights in two-rainbow independent domination of rook graphs
